instructions:
Controls a Pixelcade LED marquee (128x32 or 128x64 pixels) on an arcade cabinet, and optional Pixelcade Pulse LED strips, speaker rings, and matrices through Pixelcade's pixelweb REST API.

Ecosystem Signal Chain & Topology:
- Video / Gaming: Batocera Linux or MiSTer FPGA drives the cabinet monitor and audio.
- Marquee Display: Pixelcade acts as the dynamic auxiliary display. When games launch in Batocera or MiSTer, marquee artwork is updated to reflect the active title.
- Lighting & Pulse: Pixelcade Pulse coordinates ambient cabinet lighting and underglow effects.
- Call pixelcade_get_status first to check connectivity, active game, and Pulse hardware availability.

Usage Guidelines:
- The arcade frontend (e.g., EmulationStation on Batocera) also drives the marquee: scrolling or launching a game replaces custom marquees and stops widgets.
- Use pixelcade_show_current_game to restore the frontend's marquee or pixelcade_show_default_marquee for the fallback.
- While screensavers or locked widgets run (lock=True), call pixelcade_stop_widgets to release attract mode.

tools.description:
<use_case>
Turn the LED marquee display black.
</use_case>

<important_notes>
- The display remains powered on in standby; next command will render immediately.
- Does not affect Pulse LED strips (use pixelcade_pulse_clear for lighting).
</important_notes>
tools.name: pixelcade_blank_display

tools.description:
<use_case>
Clear the marquee queue: stop queued items that are playing and drop pending queue items.
</use_case>

<important_notes>
- Uses attract stop command, so also halts active widgets or attract-mode locks.
- If restore_current is True (default), restores the frontend's active game/system marquee.
</important_notes>

restore_current.description: Afterwards, put back the frontend's marquee (the default). False leaves the marquee as the queue clear left it.
restore_current.title: Restore Current

tools.name: pixelcade_clear_queue

tools.description:
<use_case>
Report whether the Pixelcade marquee and Pulse lighting controller are reachable,
software and firmware versions, the game or system marquee last shown by the frontend,
and Pulse LED strip state.
</use_case>

<important_notes>
- Always call this tool first before sending marquee displays or Pulse commands.
- When reachable is False, error explains why (e.g. host powered down or network timeout).
- pulse.responding is False when strips are configured but disconnected or unpowered.
</important_notes>
tools.name: pixelcade_get_status

tools.description:
<use_case>
List available marquee artwork in a folder, indicating whether still (PNG/JPG) or animated (GIF) versions exist.
</use_case>

<important_notes>
- folder is typically a system name ('mame', 'snes', 'nes', 'neogeo', 'genesis') or 'console', 'animations', 'user'.
- Artwork names can be passed as the rom parameter to pixelcade_show_game_marquee.
- Use contains to filter titles and reduce payload size.
</important_notes>

contains.description: Case-insensitive substring filter, best matches first.
contains.title: Contains

folder.description: A Batocera system (mame, snes, nes, neogeo, ...) for its games' marquees; 'console' for system marquees; 'animations' for play_animation names; 'user' for the user's own uploads.
folder.title: Folder

kind.description: any, or only names that have a still (PNG/JPG) or an animated (GIF) version.
kind.title: Kind

tools.name: pixelcade_list_artwork

tools.description:
<use_case>
List available Pixelcade Pulse lighting effect names by category, along with name patterns and named zones.
</use_case>

<important_notes>
- Does not require active hardware or network communication.
- matrix_* effects target 8x8/8x32 LED matrices; other effects target strips and speaker rings.
</important_notes>

category.description: Only this category; omit for all.
category.title: Category

tools.name: pixelcade_list_pulse_effects

tools.description:
<use_case>
Play a built-in Pixelcade animation sequence on the marquee.
</use_case>

<important_notes>
- Animation names can be discovered via pixelcade_list_artwork(folder='animations').
- loops sets how many times the animation plays before completing.
</important_notes>

loops.description: Queue it and play this many times; omit to play now.
loops.title: Loops

name.description: An animation name from list_artwork folder='animations'.
name.title: Name

tools.name: pixelcade_play_animation

tools.description:
<use_case>
Turn off Pulse LEDs and stop active lighting effects in one zone or across all zones.
</use_case>

<important_notes>
- Omit zone parameter to turn off all Pulse lighting strips, rings, and matrices simultaneously.
</important_notes>

zone.description: One zone; omit for all LEDs.
zone.title: Zone

tools.name: pixelcade_pulse_clear

tools.description:
<use_case>
Run a dynamic lighting effect on a designated Pixelcade Pulse zone (strips, speaker rings, matrices).
</use_case>

<important_notes>
- Rate limited to protect power supply and thermal dissipation.
- Intensity is capped by the server's pulse_max_brightness setting.
- Discover valid effect names with pixelcade_list_pulse_effects.
</important_notes>

color.description: A color name (red, blue, cyan, gray, darkgray, green, lightgray, magenta, orange, yellow, pink, white) or 6-digit hex like 'ff6d00'.
color.title: Color

color2.description: A color name (red, blue, cyan, gray, darkgray, green, lightgray, magenta, orange, yellow, pink, white) or 6-digit hex like 'ff6d00'.
color2.title: Color2

zone.description: A zone name (left_strip, right_strip, left_speaker_ring, right_speaker_ring, center_matrix, left_matrix, right_matrix) or a zone number 0-35.
zone.title: Zone

tools.name: pixelcade_pulse_effect

tools.description:
<use_case>
Set all LEDs in a designated Pulse zone to a solid static color.
</use_case>

<important_notes>
- Stops any animated effect currently active in that zone.
- Rate limited to protect power supply from high-draw current surges.
</important_notes>

zone.description: A zone name (left_strip, right_strip, left_speaker_ring, right_speaker_ring, center_matrix, left_matrix, right_matrix) or a zone number 0-35.
zone.title: Zone

tools.name: pixelcade_pulse_fill

tools.description:
<use_case>
Set the global brightness level for all Pixelcade Pulse LEDs.
</use_case>

<important_notes>
- Level must not exceed pulse_max_brightness (default 128) to protect hardware power rails.
- Rate limited to protect power supplies against rapid power cycling.
</important_notes>

level.description: 0-255, limited by the server's cap (see get_status).
level.title: Level

tools.name: pixelcade_set_pulse_brightness

tools.description:
<use_case>
Display a console or system banner marquee (e.g., 'snes', 'genesis', 'mame').
</use_case>

<important_notes>
- Typically displayed when browsing the system wheel in EmulationStation.
- If artwork is missing, optional fallback_text will scroll.
</important_notes>

fallback_text.description: Text to scroll if there is no artwork.
fallback_text.title: Fallback Text

tools.name: pixelcade_show_console_marquee

tools.description:
<use_case>
Restore the marquee artwork corresponding to the game or system currently selected in the frontend.
</use_case>

<important_notes>
- Useful after displaying temporary custom text or alerts to return the marquee to cabinet context.
- If attract mode or screensaver was active, restores the last game known before screensaver.
</important_notes>
tools.name: pixelcade_show_current_game

tools.description:
<use_case>
Display the Pixelcade default marquee artwork (fallback artwork).
</use_case>

<important_notes>
- Requires pixelweb version 8.0.14 or later.
- Used when no game is active or to clear custom text.
</important_notes>
tools.name: pixelcade_show_default_marquee

tools.description:
<use_case>
Display a game's marquee artwork on the Pixelcade LED display.
</use_case>

<important_notes>
- Replaces whatever is currently displayed unless loops is specified to queue it.
- Frontend navigation or game launches will overwrite this display.
- If the game has no artwork, fallback_text or the default marquee is displayed.
</important_notes>

animation.description: auto: animated then still if both exist; still: PNG only; animated: GIF only. If get_status says animated_marquees is false (Pixelcade's 'static PNG marquees only' setting), stills are shown instead.
animation.title: Animation

fallback_text.description: Text to scroll if there is no artwork.
fallback_text.title: Fallback Text

loops.description: Queue instead of replacing: play a GIF this many times (or show a still this many seconds), then move to the next queued item. Omit to show it now and keep it up.
loops.title: Loops

pulse.description: Pulse LED strips: follow the game's theme, leave them as they are, or turn them off.
pulse.title: Pulse

rom.description: ROM file name without its extension, e.g. 'pacman' or 'Super Mario World (USA)'.
rom.title: Rom

tools.name: pixelcade_show_game_marquee

tools.description:
<use_case>
Display custom text messages (scrolling or static) on the LED marquee.
</use_case>

<important_notes>
- Supports multi-line layouts (lines=2 or lines=4) using newlines.
- blink_ms is only supported for text of 9 characters or fewer.
- loops=-1 holds the text on screen until the next command is sent.
</important_notes>

blink_ms.description: Blink interval in ms. Only for 9 characters or fewer.
blink_ms.title: Blink Ms

color.description: A color name (red, blue, cyan, gray, darkgray, green, lightgray, magenta, orange, yellow, pink, white) or 6-digit hex like 'ff6d00'.
color.title: Color

lines.description: Text rows; 2 or 4 use smaller built-in fonts.
lines.title: Lines

loops.description: Show it this many times (queued behind anything already queued), then the marquee goes blank; -1 keeps it up until something else is shown. Omit to show it now, once.
loops.title: Loops

scroll.description: auto: scroll only if it doesn't fit; scroll: always; fixed: never (auto-sized).
scroll.title: Scroll

text.description: The message. Use newlines with lines=2 or 4.
text.title: Text

tools.name: pixelcade_show_text

tools.description:
<use_case>
Display a live widget on the marquee (arcade-themed clock, weather, stock ticker, sports scores, attract mode).
</use_case>

<important_notes>
- Widgets run continuously until replaced or stopped via pixelcade_stop_widgets.
- lock=True prevents frontend scrolling from interrupting the widget until stopped.
</important_notes>

clock_style.description: For clock: 'digital' or an arcade theme.
clock_style.title: Clock Style

league.description: For sports: omit for all leagues.
league.title: League

location.description: For weather: ZIP code or 'City,Country'. Omit for the location saved in Pixelcade.
location.title: Location

lock.description: Lock it in place until stop_widgets (or a game launch): frontend scrolling and other marquee calls, this server's included, are ignored meanwhile.
lock.title: Lock

teams.description: For sports: comma-separated team codes, e.g. 'SF,GB'.
teams.title: Teams

widget.description: attract runs the user's Pixelcade attract-mode playlist.
widget.title: Widget

tools.name: pixelcade_show_widget

tools.description:
<use_case>
Stop any running widget or attract-mode loop and restore normal arcade operation.
</use_case>

<important_notes>
- Also clears the attract-mode lock set during screensavers or locked widgets.
- Call this first if marquee commands appear to be ignored.
</important_notes>
tools.name: pixelcade_stop_widgets
